tasks.title: Implement ManaConfig for system parameters
tasks.objective: Create pure-Java immutable configuration class holding mana system parameters including flow rates, gathering radii, and storage limits
constraints: Pure Java implementation with no Minecraft or Fabric dependencies
Immutable class with final fields and no setters
Provides default configuration values matching product specifications
No external resource loading; values are hardcoded defaults or constructor-provided
Must not modify any existing classes
Must define flowRate (default > 0), defaultGatherRadius (default >= 1), maxStoragePerBlock (default > 0)
No thread safety requirements; single-threaded server-tick assumption
tasks.client_server_considerations: Server-only logic; no client-class references or dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Contains flowRate field with default value > 0
Contains defaultGatherRadius field with default value >= 1
Contains maxStoragePerBlock field with default value > 0
Immutable: final fields, no setters, constructor-based initialization
tasks.rationale: Provides centralized configuration for mana system parameters. Enables consistent behavior across flow, gathering, and storage components without requiring Fabric infrastructure. Default values align with MVP specifications.

tasks.title: Implement mana type interfaces for consumer, creator, and storage
tasks.objective: Create pure-Java interfaces defining the contracts for mana consumers, creators, and storage entities that mods can implement
constraints: Pure Java implementation with no Minecraft or Fabric dependencies
Interfaces only; no implementations or concrete classes
No references to existing concrete classes in method signatures
Method signatures must be compatible with SphericalGatherer and ChunkManaMap usage patterns
Must not modify any existing classes
ManaConsumer must define gather capability with position and radius
ManaCreator must define injection capability with position and radius
ManaStorage must define storage with capacity limits
tasks.client_server_considerations: Server-only logic; no client-class references or dependencies
acceptance_criteria: ManaConsumer interface defines mana gathering capability with position parameters
ManaCreator interface defines mana injection capability with position parameters
ManaStorage interface defines getStoredMana(), getCapacity(), and canAccept(double amount) methods
tasks.rationale: Establishes the type system for mana interaction. Mods will implement these interfaces to integrate with the mana system. These are foundational abstractions needed before the API can be implemented, and they are pure Java with no Fabric dependencies.
